Razma told me our House has taken another blow. Zealots have somehow infiltrated Dreshdae and taken several members of our House. I can only assume this was possible due to the state of our City. Sahima and Gavin were among them which means the Zealots took them after they had gathered a team to aid the newly homeless. Insult to injury.

So now this means I'm forced to refocus my efforts on my work. I can barely keep it together. It's going to take all my strength to maintain my composure and speak with the Head.
items.legacy_ko:
라즈마가 말하길, 우리의 가문이 또 큰 피해를 입었다고 한다. 대체 어떤 방식인지는 몰라도 광신도 무리가 드레스데 내부까지 침투한 다음, 우리의 가문 사람들 일부를 납치했다고 한다. 지금 우리 도시가 이 지경이 됐으니 그런 짓을 감행할 수 있었던 것이겠지. 사히마와 개빈이 잡혀 갔다는데, 그 말은 그 둘이 난민들을 도우려고 인원들을 모으고 난 뒤 광신도들에게 붙잡혔다는 뜻이 된다. 설상가상이로다.

다시 말해, 어쩔 수 없이 난 내 일에 최대한 집중해야 하는 것이다. 제대로 버티지도 못하는 실정인데. 장로님에게 이 소식을 전하면서 평정심을 지키려면 정말 온 힘을 다해야 할 것만 같다.

items.source_en:
They say I wander aimlessly among the steppes, but it is about the journey, is it not? There is more to learn for those that are willing, so why would you rush through your lessons? 

Every day He will teach those that adequately pursue Him. As for today, there was no lesson but my eyes lie on tomorrow. Beyond the camp in the valley and the signal towers on the horizon lies my next destination.
